shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- routing ---\\n' && sed -n '1,110p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- installed docs ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*' -iname '*dropdown*' | head -20; printf '%s\\n' '--- type ---'; rg -n \"export declare const DropdownMenu|interface DropdownMenuProps|DropdownMenuProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; printf '%s\\n' '--- setup ---'; rg -n -A35 -B3 \"Required setup\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,105p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && printf '\\n--- item ---\\n' && sed -n '1,75p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuItem.d.ts && printf '\\n--- readme ---\\n' && rg -n -A45 -B4 'DropdownMenu' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -110"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- traps relevant ---\\n'; rg -n -C4 \"Button view|Icon data|variant\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -90; printf '\\n--- icons file? ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui -maxdepth 2 -type d -name icons"

/bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- icons import ---\\n' && head -30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ChevronDown.d.ts && printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n' && rg -n \"ChevronDownIcon|ChevronDown\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head"

/bin/bash -lc "find / -type f -name 'apply_patch*' 2>/dev/null | head -30; find / -type f -name '*apply*patch*.json' 2>/dev/null | head; find /home/node/.codex -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v codex; codex --help 2>&1 | head -80; command -v claude; command -v cursor; command -v gemini'

/bin/bash -lc "find / -type f \\( -name 'aarch64-unknown-linux-musl' -o -name 'codex-linux-arm64' \\) 2>/dev/null | head; find / -type f -name 'codex-*' 2>/dev/null | head -30; find / -type f -name 'applypatch' 2>/dev/null | head -10"
